## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of what the problem is or what you want to achieve.
Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...] / It would be great if [...]

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## User Story

As a [type of user], I want [goal] so that [reason/benefit].

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1

- [ ] Criterion 3

## Technical Considerations

### Affected Components

- [ ] Frontend (Angular)
- [ ] Order Service
- [ ] Notification Service
- [ ] Shared Libraries
- [ ] Infrastructure
- [ ] CI/CD

### API Changes

Describe any changes to APIs (new endpoints, modifications, deprecations).

### Database Changes

Describe any database schema changes required.

### Security Impact

- [ ] Requires security review
- [ ] Involves authentication/authorization changes
- [ ] Handles PII or sensitive data
- [ ] No security impact

## Priority

- [ ] Critical - Blocking other work
- [ ] High - Needed for upcoming release
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have soon
- [ ] Low - Can be deferred

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
